verdict.rationale: Zero's founder describes an AI email client that lets users chat with their inbox and drafts replies. The docs list natural-language capabilities such as composing emails with AI assistance and asking questions about mailbox or thread content. That shows product-native natural-language interaction, but nothing shows users issuing natural-language commands that perform actions like archive, label, delete or send inside the product. The MCP tool list exposes those actions to external agents, which is a different story and is not credited here. Missing for 10: documented in-product natural-language command execution of mailbox actions, depth and limits of the chat interface, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
